sourceTitle: Legends of the North: The Guidman O' Inglismill and The Fairy Bride
description: "Legends of the North: The Guidman O' Inglismill and The Fairy Bride" by Buchan is a collection of Scottish folk tales written in the late 19th century. This work intertwines elements of local superstition and folklore with narratives about love and the supernatural.
